music.provenance: Original Amiga game playback captured through emulation; stereo reupload July 30 2023. Reencoded to Vorbis quality 3, preserving duration and stereo. Not a MIDI cover. Source capture packet timestamps were rebuilt from decoded sample count before Vorbis encoding; all reencoded tracks decode without timestamp warnings.

sfx.provenance: AmigaLemmings folder from LemmingsVersionsNLSounds.zip, updated January19 2024. WAV recordings converted without altering playback speed to 16-bit PCM 22050Hz mono.

caveats: Music playback is an emulator capture, not validated against real Amiga hardware by this task.
Sample associations verified against the separate firsthand WinUAE rip post at https://www.lemmingsforums.net/index.php?topic=5271.0 . Some less common effects not semantically verified.
Original Amiga Music/FX toggles music with limited effects versus no music and full effects. A modern simultaneous full mix differs.
